name: Alphalete - Page and Keyword Inventories 2026-06
body:
> Research · Alphalete · 2026-06-16

Also (same folder): `Alphalete - Pages & Posts SEO Inventory.xlsx`, `Alphalete - Keyword Planner Volumes 2026-06.xlsx`, `alphalete_seo_inventory_raw.json`, `page.xml`, `post.xml`, `category.xml`

# Summary
The June 2026 inventory and keyword workbooks built while the site was still on the old `/service-areas/` structure. They are the source of the "6 posts and 237 pages" figure: the Jun 16 inventory (from the WordPress REST API) counted **243 items: 6 posts, 237 pages**. The blog count grew to about 50 within weeks (see [Alphalete - Blog Index](lib:brain-alphalete-blog-index)).

# All Pages and Posts (Jun 16)
- Pages by service focus: Commercial Trenchless Pipelining 45, Hydro Jetting 45, Sewer Camera Inspections 45, Drain Cleaning 44, Trenchless Sewer Repair 44, site pages 11, blog posts 6, services overview 1, residential pipelining 1, other 1.
- Tabs: All Pages & Posts, Blog Posts, Service + City Pages (220), Core & Service Pages, and a "404s & Redirects" tab with GSC URLs and suggested actions.
- Columns include suggested primary keyword, status and an Indexed? flag.
- A copy saved before the indexed-status update is kept as `Alphalete - All Pages and Posts (backup before index update).xlsx`.

# Pages and Posts SEO Inventory (Jun 10)
245 rows with page name, full URL, slug, primary keyword, SEO title, meta description and type. `alphalete_seo_inventory_raw.json` is the raw data behind it.

# Keyword Planner volumes (pulled Jun 11, May 2025 to Apr 2026)
From the Alphalete Ads account (140-061-4219), US and Colorado columns:
| Keyword | US / mo | Colorado / mo |
|---|---|---|
| cured in place pipe lining (grouped with cipp lining) | 4,400 | 110 |
| no dig sewer repair | 3,600 | 110 |
| hydro jet drain cleaning | 3,600 | 50 |
| sewer scope inspection | 2,900 | 140 |
| camera inspection sewer line | 1,300 | 30 |
| tree roots in sewer line | 1,000 | 20 |
| trenchless sewer repair cost | 880 | 50 |
| sewer camera inspection cost | 720 | 10 |
| sewer repair colorado springs | 20 | 20 (top bid up to about $180) |
Many long-tail and Denver-specific terms returned no data (below threshold, not zero).

# Sitemap XML snapshots (Jun 18)
`page.xml`, `post.xml` and `category.xml` are copies of the sitemaps at that date, referenced by the Sitemap Fix work.
